Commentary.Commentary: Who saw this coming on Day 5? The game was almost looking dead coming into Day 5 with Pakistan in a comfortable position with a lot of wickets in hand but with a little help for Bangladesh they came out with a lot of determination, bowled tight and made the most out of it. Rizwan once again played a crucial role but he got no support from others. The wickets kept falling and in the end they are close to another home defeat now. Stay tuned for the chase.

A performance to remember for Bangladesh and out of nowhere they have made it possible to sneak in a victory here. There is still some work to do for the Bangladeshi batters. They need some runs to win and it is certain that the victory will arrive.

GIVE OUT! Ali has to review and he does! That though is plumb! On middle. This goes on with the arm. Ali looks to defend but plays down the wrong line. He misses and it hits the pad. An appeal and the finger is raised. A review is taken but in vain. That is the end of the innings. Bangladesh just need 30 runs to win.

Commentary.Commentary: We're back!
... DAY 5, SESSION 2 ...

For Pakistan, it all depends on Rizwan. He really needs to play a massive innings here and hope he gets able support from the tail. Shaheen has hung around so far but with two session to go, he along with the others will have to show a lot of grit. Another exciting session coming up. Join us for it in a bit.

What a first session that was! It has turned the game on its head. We expected this one to be a draw but Bangladesh have come out all guns blazing. They have managed to take five wickets and Pakistan still haven't erased the deficit. It was the pacers who started things off and then the spinners did their bit too. More of the same is what they would want after the break.

Commentary.Commentary: We are all set! The players are out in the middle.

Bangladesh on the other hand, hold the upper hand at the moment. If they manage to get a couple of wickets early, we might just be in for a surprise. They'll hope they can do so and also hope, this wicket plays a few tricks. The first session will indicate a lot as to where the game is heading too.

We are into the last day of the first Test between Bangladesh and Pakistan and a draw looks the most likeliest result. It has been slow going so far in this game with the proceedings dominated by the batters. We expect the game today as well. Pakistan trail by just below a ton and they would hope they get to that mark by not losing any wicket. Their aim will be simple, just bat and get themselves to a safe position from where they could not lose the game.
... DAY 5, SESSION 1 ...

In reply, Pakistan lost a wicket early but Masood and Shafique have done well to ensure there were no more wickets to fall. They'll now want to bat long. Pakistan still trail by 94 and would hope they can get past that without losing a wicket. Bangladesh on the other hand, will hope to get a couple quickly. They have higher chances of winning this game but they'll need to pick wickets. The wicket is quite placid and they'll need a special effort from their bowlers if they are to do so. Day 5 can turn out to be an exciting one. Join us for the action, the game begins at 4.45 AM GMT. The build-up begins a lot earlier. Till then, goodbye and take care!

Another day dominated by the batters and the most likely result for now seems a draw. Rahim was the star for Bangladesh. He batted brilliantly to help his side take a decent lead. He got able support from Mehidy.
